entities.name: Go-Shintai of Life's Origin
entities.description: Legendary shrine housing a Kami of Life's Origin that formed from the dust of kami destroyed in the Jukai forest.

entities.name: Jukai forest
entities.description: Forest on Kamigawa decimated during the expansion of Towashi.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City whose expansion decimated the Jukai forest.

events.summary: The Jukai forest was decimated during the expansion of Towashi and a number of kami crumbled into dust.

events.summary: The dust settled on an ancient shrine and coalesced into a new spirit, which wanders Kamigawa.
events.quote: The shrine took on a life and kami powers of its own.
